assignments.name: validation
content_brief
content_package

parameters.subject: ✅ Content Ready: {{ $json.content_package.content.title }}
parameters.message:
Dear {{ $('validate-content-request').item.json.validation.sanitized.client_name }},

Your content has been generated and is ready for review!

📝 **CONTENT DETAILS:**
• Title: {{ $json.content_package.content.title }}
• Type: {{ $json.content_package.content_type.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase() }}
• Word Count: ~{{ $json.content_package.content.body.split(' ').length }} words
• Read Time: {{ $json.content_package.performance_metrics.estimated_read_time }}
• SEO Score: {{ $json.content_package.performance_metrics.readability_score }}/100

🎯 **SEO OPTIMIZATION:**
• Primary Keyword: {{ $json.content_package.strategy_used.content_strategy.primary_keyword }}
• Meta Title: {{ $json.content_package.content.meta_title }}
• Meta Description: {{ $json.content_package.content.meta_description }}

📱 **SOCIAL MEDIA READY:**
• Twitter: ✅ ({{ $json.content_package.social_variants.twitter.length }}/280 chars)
• LinkedIn: ✅
• Facebook: ✅
• Instagram: ✅

📈 **PERFORMANCE PREDICTION:**
• Engagement Potential: {{ $json.content_package.performance_metrics.engagement_potential.toUpperCase() }}
• Shareability Score: {{ $json.content_package.performance_metrics.shareability_score }}/100

🔗 **NEXT STEPS:**
1. Review content in your dashboard
2. Make any necessary edits
3. Approve for publishing
4. Track performance metrics

**Content ID:** {{ $json.content_package.request_id }}

Best regards,
AI Content Team

parameters.responseBody:
={{ {
  "success": true,
  "message": "Content generated and processed successfully",
  "content_id": $json.content_package.request_id,
  "content_type": $json.content_package.content_type,
  "title": $json.content_package.content.title,
  "word_count": $json.content_package.content.body.split(' ').length,
  "readability_score": $json.content_package.performance_metrics.readability_score,
  "estimated_read_time": $json.content_package.performance_metrics.estimated_read_time,
  "engagement_potential": $json.content_package.performance_metrics.engagement_potential,
  "shareability_score": $json.content_package.performance_metrics.shareability_score,
  "publishing_status": {
    "wordpress": "draft_created",
    "social_media": "posted",
    "email": $json.content_package.content_type === 'email_newsletter' ? 'sent' : 'not_applicable',
    "landing_page": $json.content_package.content_type === 'landing_page' ? 'created' : 'not_applicable'
  },
  "next_steps": [
    "Review content in dashboard",
    "Approve for final publishing",
    "Monitor performance metrics",
    "Schedule follow-up content"
  ]
} }}
